description: Make a clean Low Poly version of one of the user's models for games, AR and the web: a closed triangle mesh at a triangle target with the textures baked on, saved as a new version and shown in the 3D viewer. Paid — 30 credits per new build (a repeat or a failed build is not charged): tell the user the price and get their OK first. Takes 1–6 min; may return a task_id for get_task.

model_id.description: model_id of one of the user's models (list_models / get_task)

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before answering with a task_id (0–50 s, default 30)

name: make_low_poly
title: Make a Low Poly version
